input.quote: During the term and for twenty-four months thereafter, Customer shall not develop, market, sell, or acquire any product or service that competes with Vendor in any territory.
input.rationale: Section 12.4 imposes a 24-month post-term, worldwide, undefined-scope non-compete on us — squarely walk-away — and contradicts Section 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we have made no non-compete commitment. Deleted; a named-product, in-term restriction with internal-development and acquisition carve-outs is the most we could consider.
